units.source_text: 我穿着学生服端正地跪坐着，显得十分拘谨。

en.t: I knelt formally in my school uniform, looking extremely stiff and constrained.

units.source_text: 可是，父亲来到这里突然心情舒畅起来。

en.t: But once my father came here, his spirits suddenly grew lighter.

units.source_text: 父亲和这里的住持虽然出身相同，他们的福气却完全迥异。

en.t: Although my father and the abbot here came from the same background, their fortunes were utterly different.

units.source_text: 父亲病弱，肌肤苍白，是一副贫相，而道诠和尚简直就像桃红色的点心。

en.t: My father was sickly, pale-skinned, and looked poor, while Priest Dosen was almost like a rosy pink confection.

units.source_text: 和尚的桌面上如山似地摞满了从四面八方寄来的小包裹、杂志、书、信等，

en.t: On the priest's desk, small parcels, magazines, books, letters, and the like sent from every direction were piled up like a mountain,

units.source_text: 都是未曾启封的，很像一座华丽的寺庙。

en.t: all still unopened, making it look very much like a splendid temple.

units.source_text: 他用胖乎乎的手拿着剪子，灵巧地拆开了其中一个小包裹。

en.t: With his plump hand he held a pair of scissors and deftly opened one of the small parcels.
